cases.description: Should trigger: first time in a repo, general orientation
cases.input: I just cloned this repository. Where do I even start? Help me understand the codebase before I change anything.
cases.expect: Five-step recon pass: read the map, learn commands, trace one flow, note conventions, write it down

cases.description: Should trigger: onboarding into a codebase before first ticket
cases.input: I'm onboarding into the payments repo. Walk me through what the code does and how to build and test it before I pick up my first ticket.
cases.expect: Repo map plus verified build/test/run commands, no code changes

cases.description: Should trigger: learn conventions before writing code
cases.input: What are the naming and testing conventions in this codebase so my PR doesn't get rejected for style?
cases.expect: Convention list from actual sources (not assumptions): naming, structure, error handling, test style

cases.description: Should trigger: trace a single flow end-to-end
cases.input: Trace how an order flows through this system from the API to the database — first time I've looked at this project.
cases.expect: One flow traced end-to-end with file:line anchors from entry point to output

cases.description: Should NOT trigger: unrelated framework comparison question
cases.input: We're choosing between React and Svelte for our next app — what are the tradeoffs?
